sponsor_or_proposer: Government of Bangladesh / Petrobangla (developer not yet selected; interested parties incl. Oman OQ Trading, Saudi Aramco Trading, Azerbaijan SOCAR, Excelerate Energy, Russia's Novatek)
current_state: Revival of a ~600 mmcfd / 4.5 mtpa third FSRU at Moheshkhali Island, Cox's Bazar. Open tender placed on back burner; govt now favours a government-to-government (G2G) deal. IIFC tasked with a feasibility study for a 4.5 mtpa facility 'in the shortest possible time'. No sponsor selected, no FID.
missing_threshold_elements: No selected developer/sponsor (G2G counterparty undecided); concrete step is only a pending feasibility study. watch_for: Selection of a G2G partner or award; completion of the IIFC feasibility study; any FID or tender award. If a named developer + concrete contract emerges, promote to new_terminal (or update the existing Summit Matarbari FSRU record if it is the same project revived).
